what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at the Bilotta Meeting Room, Lunenburg Town Hall; remote via Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=87352897617) or phone (888) 475-4499, Meeting ID 909 174 0347; also broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access, Facebook Live and YouTube.

items.agenda_line: a. Discussion and possible vote: Reserve Fund
items.why_it_matters: The committee may vote on a Reserve Fund transfer for the Collins Center Finance Operational Review (M.G.L. c. 40, §6), which is spending from the town's reserve.

items.agenda_line: c. Workshop: review of financial policies for recommendation to Select Board for adoption
items.why_it_matters: The committee will review the town's financial planning and operations policies (audit, budget process, capital planning, debt, reserves, investments, procurement and others listed) before recommending them to the Select Board for adoption.

items.agenda_line: b. Post-Special Town Meeting discussion and recommendations
items.why_it_matters: The committee will discuss the Special Town Meeting and may make recommendations afterward.

preview.hook: Reserve Fund transfer for the Collins Center financial review, financial policy workshop, and post-Special Town Meeting talk
preview.one_line: Finance Committee, Dec 3, 7 PM: possible vote on a Reserve Fund transfer for the Collins Center review, a financial policies workshop, and post-Special Town Meeting discussion.
